lines.text: ADDENDA ET CORRIGENDA.
P. 6. (Text) line 1, from bottom add R. and P. after W.

R. commentary ; and substitute M. for “&—R.”

delete श्रवण etc. to ला, substitute श्रवणसुखस्यैवतात्पर्यम्

°न्समना noted in R. ; line 6 from bottom after (b)
add त्यक्त्वा ; कृत्वा M. ; line 3 from bottom at the
end add °हा° ; °दा° M.

R. commentary.

after T.
